title: Parking tickets 2010-2013
description:
The City of Vancouver regulates parking to balance the needs of residents, commuters, and visitors. This dataset includes parking ticket records data available from Parking Operations and Enforcement branch from 2010 to 2013.

Due to platform limitation, records from other years need to split into multiple datasets. See other parking tickets datasets for data starting from 2010.

Notes:

  • This dataset does not include parking tickets issued by Vancouver Police Department
  • Ticket issued location information was aggregated to 100-block unit level.​
  • Testing in production may result in test record
  • Effective April 30, 2018, data files starting from year 2011 have been updated to reflect change in new software platform.​​

Data access

​Year 2010 data was extracted from a legacy software platform and its format is not compatible with our new platform. This link provides access to the file from our legacy site:

  • ​2010 Parking tickets (CSV)
